tooltip.merged_magic.dolphins_breath.des: Grants water breathing at the water's surface
tooltip.merged_magic.springy_piston.desc: Launches the player off the ground and temporarily crutches their fall
tooltip.merged_magic.amethyst_mirror.des: Reflects your current positions lighting onto undead mobs around you, damaging them and setting them ablaze
tooltip.merged_magic.prospectors_pan.des: Samples high value ores within the area, then carves a path to the closest one
tooltip.merged_magic.jungle_vine.desc: Consumes durability to place vines wherever the player climbs, regenerates durability over time and never breaks
tooltip.merged_magic.hot_cocoa.desc: Protects the user from freezing and slowness when drunk, refill by crafting with cocoa beans
tooltip.merged_magic.target_frisbee.desc: Throws a frisbee that glows a target, and makes them take 1.5x more projectile damage
tooltip.merged_magic.hermes_boots.desc: When on the ground, grants you a quick speed boost and lasting levitation
